name: oidc-demo
description: Frontend assets of the OpenID Connect demo
author: g10f

scripts.build: npm run css && npm run vendor
scripts.css: sass --load-path=node_modules --quiet-deps --silence-deprecation=import apps/static/scss/main.scss apps/static/css/main.css && sass --load-path=node_modules --quiet-deps --silence-deprecation=import --style=compressed --no-source-map apps/static/scss/main.scss apps/static/css/main.min.css
scripts.vendor: cp node_modules/bootstrap/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js node_modules/bootstrap/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js.map apps/static/js/vendor/ && cp node_modules/bootstrap-icons/font/bootstrap-icons.css node_modules/bootstrap-icons/font/bootstrap-icons.min.css apps/static/font/ && cp node_modules/bootstrap-icons/font/fonts/bootstrap-icons.woff node_modules/bootstrap-icons/font/fonts/bootstrap-icons.woff2 apps/static/font/fonts/
